name: Shiina Kanade
source:
[url=http://vndb.org/c12571]Inori's[/url] mother and good friends with Taisuke's mother [url=http://vndb.org/c12555]Ena[/url]. She likes to talk to [url=http://vndb.org/c12570]Taisuke[/url] and his sister [url=http://vndb.org/c12554]Konoha[/url] and enjoys when they come visit her daughter. Although she wears a wedding ring she is separated from her husband either through death or separation.

[spoiler] In the extended side story she gives birth to Taisuke's daughter and becomes pregnant again with his second child. [/spoiler]
